description: An insurance loss run (claims/loss report): the claims history an insurer or risk pool reports for one insured member, summarised by coverage period with grand totals. Used by underwriters and brokers to price renewals.

report.description: Report-level details from the page header and footer.

report_title.description: Title of the report as printed, e.g. 'Claim/Loss Report'.

carrier_name.description: Insurer or risk pool that produced the report, from the logo or footer.

insured_member.description: The insured or pool member the report covers, from 'Member Selected'.

line_of_coverage.description: Line of coverage the claims fall under, e.g. 'Workers' Compensation'.

coverage_year_range.description: The coverage period year range the report was run for, as printed, e.g. 'Between 2015 and 2019'.

report_run_date.description: Date the report was run, from the footer, as YYYY-MM-DD.

policies.description: One entry per coverage (policy) period, from the section header line that opens each period's claim listing ('Coverage Number: ... Coverage Period: ...').

coverage_number.description: Coverage (policy) number shown in the period's section header, e.g. 'WC-00548-201501'.

period_start.description: Start of the coverage period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end.description: End of the coverage period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

coverage_periods.description: The per-period summary rows on the last page, directly above the line-of-coverage total and the Grand Total. There is one row per coverage period; take them from that summary block only, not from the 'Totals:' rows that also close each period's section on earlier pages.

items.description: One row of the period summary.

period.description: The period label exactly as printed after 'Totals:', e.g. 'Jan 1, 2016- Jan 1, 2017'.

claim_count.description: Count of claims in the period.

total_paid.description: Total paid on the period's claims, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

total_outstanding_reserve.description: Total outstanding reserve on the period's claims, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

subtotal.description: Subtotal (paid plus outstanding reserve), in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

deductible.description: Deductible amount, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

loss_recoveries.description: Loss recoveries (subrogation and similar), in dollars. Negative when printed in parentheses. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

total_incurred.description: Total incurred for the period after deductible and recoveries, from the Total column, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

grand_total.description: The report's Grand Total row across all coverage periods.

claim_count.description: Total count of claims across all periods.

total_paid.description: Grand total paid, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

total_outstanding_reserve.description: Grand total outstanding reserve, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

subtotal.description: Grand total subtotal (paid plus outstanding reserve), in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

deductible.description: Grand total deductible, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

loss_recoveries.description: Grand total loss recoveries, in dollars. Negative when printed in parentheses. A printed $0 is 0, not null.

total_incurred.description: Grand total incurred, from the Total column, in dollars. A printed $0 is 0, not null.
